newsitem.title: FRANCE: French court fines Le Pen for "mad fat zebu" jibe.
newsitem.headline: French court fines Le Pen for "mad fat zebu" jibe.

text.p: A Paris court fined extreme-right National Front leader Jean-Marie Le Pen on Friday for calling the head of an anti-racism organisation a "mad fat zebu".
The court ruled that Le Pen's remark last year aimed at SOS-Racisme head Fode Sylla, a burly Frenchman of Senegalese origin, constituted a racial slur and fined him 5,000 francs ($850).
A zebu is a hump-backed domestic ox found in Africa, India and China.
The court said in its verdict that the word zebu "corresponds in the public mind to a fat, grazing mammal whose propensity for action and reflection appears to be little developed".
Le Pen had also intended the remark as a reference to Sylla's origins, the court said.

Le Pen had made the remark in response to Sylla's statement that the Front leader had "blood on his hands" in the 1990 desecration of a Jewish cemetery in the southern town of Carpentras by neo-Nazis.
